verdict: Paid ads hold at 5x return, but this week showed a clear pullback.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered a 5.01 return on ad spend, turning $1,482 in spend into $7,423 in revenue across 39 purchases. However, the most recent 7 days showed a step down — ROAS fell 21.6% week-over-week, purchases dipped 8%, and the last three days of the window recorded only 3 purchases compared to 8 in the three days prior. The pullback aligns with a 14% reduction in daily spend and a near-complete drop in Google Business Profile visibility, which hit zero actions on September 12 and 13. Ad creative is being reviewed this week and GBP visibility is being investigated to restore organic local reach ahead of the next period.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend over the last 28 days
purchases driven by paid ads this period
drop in Google Business Profile actions in the last 7 days

watch_item.issue: 57% of your ad budget is concentrated in a single campaign — if that campaign softens, there is no second campaign to absorb the load.
watch_item.fix: A second campaign is being structured to distribute budget and reduce dependency on one audience.
